components: a large loop curling inward on the left
a descending stem at the loop's right edge
an adjacent rising middle stem and top bar
strokeOrder: start at the lower left and climb around the large outer loop
without lifting, curve over the top and curl inward to the central junction
without lifting, draw the adjoining stem straight down — then lift once
set the pen at the bottom of the adjacent middle upright and rise to the top
without lifting again, carry the top bar to the right edge — then lift a second time
set the pen at the top of the separate right upright and draw straight down — and only now lift
strokeOrderNote: three strokes — three joined loop-and-descent movements, one lift, the joined middle rise and top bar, a second lift, then the right upright; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I, Frame 12, ள

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 12, ள (University of Texas at Austin), p. 195
strokeOrderSource.variation: Module 12 identifies ள as the retroflex lateral, contrasts it with ல, and directs learners to Appendix I. Frame 12 numbers six movements in three pen-down runs: joined movements 1–3, joined movements 4–5, and separate movement 6. Tamil handwriting varies by school; this is one attested order fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline.

notes: The retroflex lateral, made with the tongue tip curled back toward the hard palate. Frame 12's six numbered movements are three strokes, not six: movements 1–3 stay joined through the left loop and descent, movements 4–5 join the middle rise to the top bar, and movement 6 is the separate right upright.
